layers.title: Grounds
layers.note: Traced against three features the illustration and the real world share: I-35 down the east edge (lon -93.7800), County Road G50 across the bottom right (lat 41.29340) and N Cross St / Walnut Trail on the west (lon -93.8055). The artwork is an illustration, not a survey, so treat pin positions as approximate.

layers.title: Concourse
layers.note: Fitted to the grounds map on the three landmarks both illustrations draw — the west entrance, the south entrance and the stage — which puts the concourse artwork at 13° off north, 487 m by 649 m, with the three landmarks landing within 30 m of where the grounds map puts them. Every icon the artwork's legend defines is pinned here — food, bars, water, toilets, merch, help desks, shade, emergency exits and the rest — traced off the centre of each stamp. Its pins appear once you're zoomed inside the gates.
